description: Companion to drivers_v1 in a counterfactual state where money funds hold ON RRP balances and fund Treasury purchases from them rather than from deposits. Money funds get the same $500 billion of added bill holdings as in drivers_v1, built evenly over fiscal years 2027 and 2028 and held through 2036, measured against a baseline in the same state.
boundaries: Illustrative scenario accounting, not a forecast or causal estimate

Counterfactual funding state: the opening money-fund ON RRP balance is set to the December 2022 peak of total ON RRP (an upper bound on money-fund use), although money funds held essentially no ON RRP at the 2026 opening
In this state money-fund purchases draw on ON RRP and money-fund receipts return to it, so money-fund flows pass nothing through to covered deposits

Every scenario puts the TGA on the operating-cash path at each fiscal-year end (within a year it sits below the path by issuance awaiting settlement), so financing-cost differences change the debt rather than the TGA
Compare each run with this family's baseline, not with drivers_v1's

calibration.size: Same $500 billion position and FY2027-FY2028 build as drivers_v1.
calibration.funding_state: Money-fund deposit pass-through 0 and the trc_routing_onrrp_available_v1.json routing (money-fund ON RRP share 1, opening balance from FRED RRPONTSYD on 2022-12-30).

scenarios.label: Money funds hold $500 billion more bills, paid from ON RRP
